assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not contain separate questions to measure domestic and care work for each person. Domestic and care work appears only as a reason for not looking for work (Pregunta 6, Opción 11), as a status/category of inactivity (Pregunta 7, Opción 2), or as a reason for not working more hours (Pregunta 60, Opción 6). Per the indicator definition, mentioning domestic work only as a category of inactivity or a reason for not working does not satisfy the indicator requirement.
